title: Famous symbols and what they mean

source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia

rows.label: Statue of Liberty
rows.symbol: freedom, and a welcome to newcomers arriving in America
rows.hook: is a colossal copper-clad woman holding a torch aloft in a harbor, a gift from overseas friends

rows.label: ouroboros
rows.symbol: a cycle that ends and begins again forever
rows.description: symbolic serpent with its tail in its mouth
rows.hook: shows a snake or dragon devouring its own tail

rows.label: yin and yang
rows.symbol: opposite forces that balance each other
rows.description: concept of dualism and complementarity in Chinese philosophy, cosmology, traditional medicine, fengshui, and protoscience, opposing “yang“ (for solar, masculine, active, warm) with “yin“ (for lunar, feminine, passive, cool)
rows.hook: is the ancient Chinese idea of paired cosmic principles, often drawn as a black and white swirl

rows.label: bald eagle
rows.symbol: the United States, its strength and freedom
rows.description: species of bird of prey found in North America
rows.hook: is a white-headed bird of prey that snatches fish from open water across Canada and Alaska

rows.label: evil eye
rows.symbol: a curse cast by a jealous or hostile stare
rows.description: curse believed to be cast by a malevolent glare, causing many cultures to create measures against it
rows.hook: is a superstition that an envious look can bring misfortune, warded off by protective amulets

rows.label: fleur-de-lis
rows.description: stylized iris flower used as a heraldic symbol
rows.hook: is a stylized lily shape found on old royal coats of arms and on Quebec's flags

rows.label: Star of David
rows.description: Jewish national, cultural and religious symbol

rows.label: caduceus
rows.symbol: Hermes, the messenger god, and trade
rows.description: staff carried by Hermes in Greek mythology

rows.label: Uncle Sam
rows.description: personification of the United States of America and its government
rows.hook: is a patriotic figure in a top hat, known for a World War I recruiting poster

rows.label: ankh
rows.hook: is a T-shaped hieroglyph topped with a teardrop loop, often drawn in the hands of gods

rows.label: hamsa
rows.symbol: protection from harm and bad luck
rows.hook: is a palm-shaped amulet used in jewelry and wall hangings, said to ward off the evil eye

rows.label: Lady Justice
rows.hook: is a figure holding scales and a sword, often shown blindfolded, seen at courthouses

rows.label: Eye of Horus
rows.symbol: protection and good health, in ancient Egypt
rows.description: ancient Egyptian symbol of protection, royal power and good health

rows.label: Jolly Roger
rows.hook: is a black flag bearing a skull and crossbones

rows.label: infinity symbol
rows.hook: is a sideways figure eight, nicknamed the lazy eight, introduced to mathematics by John Wallis

rows.label: four-leaf clover
rows.description: a variation/mutation of the common clover, rare and said to bring good luck
rows.hook: is a rare lawn find with an extra leaflet, hunted by people hoping for fortune
